description: Add and/or remove tags across up to 300 monitors in one call, all or nothing: each monitor ends with (its tags | add) - remove. Use it to retag a fleet; to replace one monitor's whole tag list use update_monitor, to rename or drop a tag everywhere (heartbeats too) use rename_tag or delete_tag. Requires a key with the write scope. At least one of add or remove is required, and they must not share a tag (422). A monitor that would end with more than 10 tags rejects the whole call (422). Each tag is trimmed, lowercased and deduplicated on write, at most 50 characters of a-z, 0-9 and : _ . / -, starting with a letter or digit. Reuse names from list_tags rather than inventing near-duplicates. Returns monitors_updated. Example: {"monitor_ids": ["<id from list_monitors>", "<id from list_monitors>"], "add": ["env:prod"], "remove": ["env:staging"]}

add.description: Tags to add to every listed monitor, up to 10.

monitor_ids.description: 1 to 300 distinct monitor uuids from list_monitors. A repeated id is a 422; an unknown id rejects the whole call with a 404 naming every id not found.

remove.description: Tags to remove from every listed monitor, up to 10.

name: bulk_update_monitor_tags
title: Retag several monitors at once
